recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed unless a future publication process intentionally regenerates historical release artifacts; those should not be manually edited for current-source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-46012 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 OO change request to correct the misspelled word "catefory" to "category" in the risk-class concept definition for the Device Specification Category CodeSystem.
initial_application: Git commit bb51b1e7004e77e141bbffa73db4312fb86942c8, titled FHIR-46012, changed source/device/codesystem-device-specification-category.xml from "Class or catefory of risk." to "Class or category of risk." The current source still contains the corrected definition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists device and devicedefinition as active resources assigned to OO, so the CodeSystem source in source/device is in current build scope and feeds the DeviceDefinition specification category binding. A source search found no remaining "catefory" spelling. The only remaining match discovered outside current source is in tools/history/release5/valuesets.xml, a historical release snapshot. Confluence meeting notes reference FHIR-46012 as OO Approved, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already carries the accepted spelling correction.
